subject.title: feat(voice-call): implement asynchronous email delivery for consult results

question: Should voice-call support asynchronous email delivery, and if so, should it be built behind a maintained recipient-verification and mail-sending boundary rather than expanding the generic realtime-consult SDK and delegating sending to an `exec`-enabled agent?
rationale: This decides a persistent user-facing delivery promise, email-recipient privacy boundary, and plugin-SDK contract; the patch cannot safely choose those product and security semantics on its own.

options.title: Approve a plugin-owned mail contract
options.body: Define recipient verification, an approved send mechanism, delivery-failure behavior, and a narrow plugin-local interface before accepting a revised implementation.

options.title: Keep voice calls synchronous
options.body: Decline asynchronous email delivery and retain the current consult behavior until a supported delivery contract exists.

options.title: Route the optional workflow outside core
options.body: Require this workflow to use an external plugin or integration that owns its mail credentials, recipient consent, and delivery lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve a plugin-owned mail contract
recommendation.body: Define recipient verification, an approved send mechanism, delivery-failure behavior, and a narrow plugin-local interface before accepting a revised implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously reviewed the relevant realtime tool-policy and sensitive-data boundary on this PR.
